extras.textures: PBR 2048px: base color, roughness, metallic, normal (baked)
extras.real_size: enchanted sword in a rune plinth, approx. 60 x 60 x 144 cm, sword approx. 110 cm
extras.notes: octagonal two-step lilac-grey stone plinth with a pale top stone, glowing cyan symbol inlays (star, spiral, circle, triangle, dot) on the core and a glowing circle with dots on top; a noble sword stands point-down in it: softly glowing cyan steel blade 'enchanted-sword_weapon_blade_glow' (emissive, unbaked, parented to the hilt), swept gold crossguard with a pink gem, blue grip, disc pommel; two glowing rings float around the blade, a few sparkles, small crystals and moss at the base. Moving part: 'enchanted-sword_weapon' (hilt with blade as child), origin at the entry point on the plinth top, pull it out along +Z (blade continues 14 cm inside); no text, no letters

origin.detail: Built procedurally with Blender scripts. The scripts were written with the help of an AI coding assistant. No generative AI model produced the geometry or textures directly.
